title: NSClient: WIFI connection option ignored
body:
Hi,

NSClient still tries to sync when WIFI is connected even option is disabled in settings.
Seems that WIFI option has no effect on sync. All other options (charging, battery, mobile network,...) are working OK.

Result: 
07:56:46.715 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-35] D/NSCLIENT: [NSClientPlugin.onStart$lambda-5():116]: ERROR io.socket.engineio.client.EngineIOException: xhr poll error

Background:
My NS server is not reachable via WIFI, only when connected via mobile network. If I am on wifi, NSClient alwa<s try to sync and I get an "ERROR io.socket.engineio.client.EngineIOException: xhr poll error" error. Not sure this is responsible for higher CPU load / battery usage.

AndroidAPS 3.1.0.3+autoISF2.2.8.1
NS-Version 14.2.6
